verdict.rationale: The Division documents a machine-readable bulk channel: 1099 XML files accepted via the DE Taxpayer Portal using IRS IRIS schema formats. It also lists a 'For Tax Software Developers' section, which suggests a developer program, but its contents are not evidenced. The XML upload still goes through an authenticated portal session; no API is exposed (OpenAPI probes return 404), and no enrollment or transmitter-registration path is shown. missing for 10: documented system accounts or transmitter/batch-provider program details, published enrollment path, true system-to-system (non-portal) submission channel, independent corroboration.
